claims.claim: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 3.8 Flash Live, featuring sub-150ms speech-to-speech latency and dynamic live avatar synthesis.
claims.notes: Direct primary release from Google DeepMind.

claims.claim: Gemini 3.8 Flash Live integrates real-time Extended Thinking, enabling multi-step problem solving during live voice interactions.
claims.notes: Allows real-time reasoning without dropping conversational fluidity.

claims.claim: The system introduces synchronized live photorealistic visual avatar generation driven directly by the model's audio output stream.
claims.notes: End-to-end multi-modal streaming without separate lip-sync post-processing.

claims.claim: Inference operates with 4x reduced memory footprint using speculative stream decoding to maintain low latency.
claims.notes: Hardware optimized across Google TPU v5e/v6e pods.

claims.claim: Gemini 3.8 Flash Live is an interactive conversational system; it does not replace batch video rendering models or offline foundation trainers.
claims.notes: CRITICAL BOUNDARY: Distinguish live conversational avatar from offline video generators.

uncertainties: High-speed avatar generation requires sustained 5G or broadband connection for 60fps streaming.
